__baseline_prompt__.text: Create an editorial fashion photograph in which a person is visible on the passenger deck of a ferry just after it leaves the harbor. The person stands in an unhurried pause beside the glass windbreak; the receding pier appears behind in the glass while a pale stretch of shoreline opens ahead, making the crossing feel newly real. The same supplied portrait guides the person's visible face and dark, straight hair with a soft fringe. The person's thoughtfully layered outfit has clean lines and one muted accent, its fabric shifting gently in the deck breeze so clothing remains the image's clear visual focus. A generous full-length frame keeps the person's face, hair and layered silhouette readable while showing both shoe soles resting flat on the ferry deck, the legs relaxed and the person's weight balanced over both feet; the deck remains visible around the shoes, with the pier and open water still legible behind. Cool sky light washes the glass, crossed by a narrow warm cabin reflection that echoes the person's profile. An almost-smile and steady, easy bearing bring subtle human appeal; the photograph feels observed, poised at the instant between leaving and arriving.
